props.flavor: One tier of the great stepped pyramid, its riser choked with moss and its tread wide enough to fight across.
props.summary: Pyramid terrace tier, walkable ledge dominates zone

props.name: Wyrmling Clutch Egg
props.base: net-new: a single oversized leathery/stone egg nested in torn foliage, rounded silhouette taller than a person
props.flavor: A mottled egg the size of a barrel, warm to the touch and faintly ticking from within.
props.summary: Barrel-sized nested egg, warm and faintly stirring

props.name: Ossuary Cairn
props.flavor: A heaped cairn of bleached bones, some clearly beast, some less easy to place.
props.summary: Heaped bleached-bone cairn, mixed beast and other

props.name: Offertory Table
props.flavor: A low stone offering-table cluttered with cracked pottery and long-spoiled fruit.
props.summary: Low stone offering table, cracked pottery clutter

props.name: Sunken Reflecting Pool
props.flavor: A rain-fed ceremonial pool gone to algae and silt, still ringed by carved frog-gods.
props.summary: Algae-choked ceremonial pool, frog-god rim carvings

props.name: Rope-Vine Archway
props.flavor: A collapsed temple gateway held together now only by a lattice of thick jungle vine.
props.summary: Vine-lashed collapsed gateway, half-standing archway

props.name: Feathered-Serpent Throne
props.flavor: A moss-grown royal seat carved with an interlocking serpent motif, its occupant long since dust.
props.summary: Moss-grown serpent throne, long-abandoned royal seat

props.name: Idol-Bearer's Crate Stack
props.flavor: Woven reed baskets and lashed crates left by looters or pilgrims, split open and spilling grain.
props.summary: Spilled reed-basket and crate stack, looter leavings

props.name: Sun-Priest Sarcophagus
props.flavor: A carved stone coffin lid depicting a robed priest, cracked open and long since emptied.
props.summary: Cracked priest sarcophagus, robed-figure carved lid

props.name: Fossil Rib Colonnade
props.base: net-new: a row of huge curved bone-ribs arching overhead like a colonnade, embedded in rock strata
props.flavor: A row of titanic curved ribs, fossilized into the cliff face, forming a bone-arched processional.
props.summary: Fossilized rib-arch colonnade, titanic bones in strata

props.name: Expedition Base Camp Tent
props.base: net-new: a canvas tent shelter, guy-lines staked out, low profile with a peaked roof
props.flavor: A weathered canvas tent abandoned mid-dig, its flap still tied against a storm that never came.
props.summary: Abandoned canvas dig-tent, full-side canvas cover

props.name: Cracked Water Cistern
props.flavor: A moss-rimmed stone cistern that once fed the temple's fountains, now dry and split at the base.
props.summary: Dry cracked cistern, moss-rimmed stone basin

props.name: Vine-Choked Portcullis
props.flavor: A rusted iron gate half-swallowed by roots, jammed forever between open and shut.
props.summary: Root-jammed iron portcullis, rusted half-open gate

props.name: Surveyor's Cart
props.flavor: A two-wheeled expedition cart, axle snapped, still loaded with crated relics under a torn tarp.
props.summary: Broken expedition cart, tarp-covered relic crates

props.name: Glyph-Warded Grate
props.flavor: A floor grate stamped with warding glyphs, air rising warm and wrong from whatever lies beneath.
props.summary: Warded floor grate, warm air rising from below

props.name: Bone-Feathered Hanging Cage
props.flavor: A woven cage of bone and hide swinging from a temple beam, its last occupant long picked clean.
props.summary: Swinging bone-and-hide cage, long-picked temple relic

props.name: Priest-Bound Manacle Wall
props.flavor: A carved wall of stone cuffs where lesser priests once bound sacrifices before the idol.
props.summary: Stone-cuffed sacrifice wall, carved binding stations

props.name: Temple Refuse Midden
props.flavor: A slumped heap of broken pottery shards, gnawed bone, and rot swept out from the shrine's back door.
props.summary: Slumped shrine refuse heap, shards and gnawed bone

props.name: Amber-Set Resin Block
props.base: net-new: a translucent amber-colored resin block embedded with a preserved silhouette, roughly torso-height
props.flavor: A block of ancient hardened resin, golden and cloudy, holding some small winged thing forever mid-flight.
props.summary: Amber resin block, winged creature frozen inside

props.name: Calcified Lava Vent
props.base: net-new: a low cracked stone vent in the ground, faintly glowing and venting heat-shimmer
props.flavor: A fissure in the temple floor that breathes sulfurous heat, its edges rimed in mineral crust.
props.summary: Cracked heat-vent fissure, sulfurous mineral-rimed crack

props.name: Claw-Scored Watch Totem
props.base: net-new: a tall wooden or bone totem pole carved with layered predator faces, scored with deep claw gouges
props.flavor: A tall totem of stacked predator visages, its lower half raked with claw marks fresher than the carving.
props.summary: Claw-scored predator totem, layered carved visages

props.name: Nest of Woven Bramble
props.base: net-new: a huge shallow bowl-shaped nest of woven branches and bramble, wide enough to hold a large creature
props.flavor: An enormous woven nest of thorned branches, lined with shed scales and the bones of past meals.
props.summary: Huge thorned bramble nest, scale-lined predator lair

props.name: Tar Pit Pool
props.flavor: A black tar seep bubbling sluggishly, half a great beast's ribs jutting from its skin.
props.summary: bubbling tar pit, half cover

props.name: Jungle Liana Curtain
props.flavor: A hanging curtain of braided lianas thick as arms, alive with beetles and slow green light.
props.summary: hanging liana curtain, half cover

props.name: Standing Megalith
props.flavor: A single leaning megalith older than the jungle, its face pocked with cupmarks that hold rainwater.
props.summary: leaning megalith, three-quarters cover

props.name: Bone Midden Mound
props.flavor: A reeking midden of cracked marrow-bones heaped against a cave mouth, picked and re-picked.
props.summary: bone midden mound, half cover

props.name: Sacrificial Cenote
props.flavor: A round sinkhole cenote plunging into black water, its rim slick with offering-blood and orchids.
props.summary: sacrificial cenote shaft, half cover

props.name: Petrified Stump Circle
props.flavor: A ring of petrified tree-stumps worn into seats, a cold pit of ash at the center.
props.summary: petrified stump ring, half cover

props.name: Rotted Coffin
props.flavor: A cheap wooden box has split along its seam, spilling grave-dirt across the floor.
props.summary: splintered wooden coffin, lid ajar, half-buried

props.name: Sunken Gravestone
props.flavor: The name has weathered to a smear, but something still scratches at the stone from below.
props.summary: tilted weathered headstone, moss-eaten, in-zone marker

props.name: Wax-Choked Candelabra
props.flavor: Black tallow has run down its arms in frozen rivulets, guttering with a cold blue flame.
props.summary: tarnished iron candelabra, black wax, sickly blue flame

props.name: Scorched Ritual Circle
props.flavor: Runes burned into the stone still smoke faintly, ringed by a residue that clings to bare skin.
props.summary: burnt sigil-ring on the floor, no cover, area hazard

props.name: Rusted Hanging Cage
props.flavor: A body-sized cage creaks on its chain, old bones rattling loose between the bars.
props.summary: chained iron cage overhead, bones rattling inside

props.name: Rusted Iron Maiden
props.flavor: Its spiked door hangs open on one hinge, dark stains long since gone to rust.
props.summary: upright spiked torture cabinet, door ajar, heavy cover

props.name: Cracked Scrying Mirror
props.flavor: The silvering has curdled black at the edges, and the reflection lags a half-second behind the room.
props.summary: tall standing mirror, spiderwebbed crack, wrong reflection

props.name: Cursed Doll Heap
props.flavor: Dozens of stitched poppets are piled together, button eyes tracking anyone who passes.
props.summary: pile of stitched dolls, button eyes, watching heap

props.name: Blood-Slick Altar
props.flavor: A wide stone slab grooved to channel runoff, still tacky with old offerings.
props.summary: grooved stone sacrifice altar, blood-blackened, three-quarter cover

props.name: Cobweb Mass
props.flavor: Decades of web have knitted the corner shut, thick enough to swallow a thrown torch.
props.summary: floor-to-ceiling web tangle, sealed corner, dense cover

props.name: Guttering Grave-Torch
props.flavor: The flame burns an unnatural shade of green and never seems to shrink the wick.
props.summary: wall-mounted torch, sickly green flame, never gutters out

props.name: Bone-Picket Fence
props.flavor: Femurs and ribs have been lashed together into a fence line no animal will cross.
props.summary: lashed-bone fence line, waist-high, animals avoid it

props.name: Wraith-Bound Manacles
props.flavor: The chains hang taut in the air as if still gripped by a struggling wrist no one can see.
props.summary: wall manacles, chains taut, gripping nothing visible

props.name: Rust-Locked Portcullis
props.flavor: The gate has fused to its groove with rust and grave-moss, sealing the passage for good.
props.summary: corroded iron portcullis, fused shut, seals the passage

props.name: Weeping Font
props.flavor: Dark water seeps up from below no matter how many times the basin is emptied.
props.summary: stone font basin, weeping black water, never runs dry

props.name: Shrouded Processional Bier
props.flavor: A funeral litter sits abandoned mid-route, its shroud stiff with old rain and older stains.
props.summary: abandoned funeral litter, stiff shroud, mid-procession halt

props.name: Death-Mask Wall
props.flavor: Rows of plaster faces, cast from the dead, line the wall in silent ranked witness.
props.summary: wall of cast death-masks, ranked rows, silent witnesses

props.name: Shattered Confessional
props.flavor: The lattice screen has been clawed through from the penitent's side, not the priest's.
props.summary: splintered confessional booth, screen clawed inward

props.name: Vigil Candle Rack
props.flavor: Hundreds of stub candles burn for the unnamed dead, none of them ever quite going out.
props.summary: tiered votive rack, hundreds of stubs, none extinguish

props.name: Embalming Table
props.flavor: Stained leather straps still dangle from a slab built for a purpose no one asks about.
props.summary: stained slab table, dangling straps, grim clinical purpose

props.name: Ancestor Throne
props.flavor: A seat of black wood carved with a hundred watching faces, all facing the wrong way.
props.summary: carved black-wood throne, hundred faces, all watching inward

props.name: Reliquary Crate Stack
props.flavor: Shipping crates stamped with a dead chapel's seal, nailed shut a little too many times.
props.summary: stacked reliquary crates, over-nailed, sealed chapel stamp

props.name: Choir-Loft Grate
props.flavor: A floor grate below the old choir loft leaks a draft that carries faint, wrong harmonies.
props.summary: iron floor grate, cold draft, faint wrong harmonies

props.name: Fogged Reliquary Case
props.flavor: A cracked glass case holds a relic wrapped in fog that never clears no matter the room's air.
props.summary: cracked display case, permanent internal fog, holds a relic

props.name: net-new: Shroud-Draped Loom
props.flavor: A tall weaving frame strung with hair-fine thread instead of yarn, still faintly rocking.
props.summary: upright loom, hair-thin thread, rocking with no wind

props.name: net-new: Sin-Eater's Bowl Stand
props.flavor: A tripod stand holds a chipped wooden bowl, always a little warm and never quite empty.
props.summary: tripod offering-bowl stand, warm to the touch, never empties

props.name: net-new: Charnel Pit
props.flavor: A sunken trench choked with old remains, its edges soft where the ground has given way.
props.summary: sunken bone-choked pit, area hazard, crumbling edges

props.name: net-new: Whispering Curtain Row
props.flavor: A row of heavy funerary drapes hangs floor to ceiling, murmuring faintly when no one is near.
props.summary: hanging drape row, floor-to-ceiling, murmurs when unwatched

props.name: Candle Forest
props.flavor: A thicket of hundreds of guttering votive candles grown together in wax, flames leaning at you.
props.summary: grove of votive candles, half cover

props.name: Hanging Cocoon Cluster
props.flavor: A cluster of silk-wrapped cocoons swaying from the rafters, some the wrong size for insects.
props.summary: hanging cocoon cluster, half cover

props.name: Graveyard Iron Fence
props.flavor: A run of spear-topped cemetery railing, its gate hanging on one hinge, finials sheared to spikes.
props.summary: iron cemetery railing, half cover

props.name: Plague Cart
props.flavor: A two-wheeled plague cart still half-loaded, a stained sheet drawn over the shapes beneath.
props.summary: loaded plague cart, three-quarters cover

props.name: Weeping Statue
props.flavor: A mourning angel statue streaked with what looks too much like tears, one hand outstretched.
props.summary: mourning angel statue, three-quarters cover

props.name: Funeral Pyre Frame
props.flavor: A timber funeral pyre built and never lit, the shrouded form atop it beaded with frost.
props.summary: unlit funeral pyre, half cover

props.name: Riveted Standpipe Tank
props.flavor: A squat steel water tower on stub legs, its service door painted shut more than once.
props.summary: riveted standpipe water tank, stub legs, painted-shut hatch

props.name: Ribbon-Bound Colossus
props.flavor: A gift box the size of a wagon, its bow cinched tight enough to have stopped something from getting out.
props.summary: giant present box, tight ribbon, oversized crate reskin

props.name: Peppermint Column
props.flavor: A twisted candy-cane pillar, tacky-sweet and sticky to the touch, standing sentinel over the parade route.
props.summary: candy-cane pillar, sticky spiral stripe, standard pillar reskin

props.name: Snapped Peppermint Stub
props.flavor: A candy-cane column sheared off mid-twist, its jagged sugar-glass edge still glinting.
props.summary: broken candy-cane stub, jagged sugar-glass edge

props.name: Nursery Block Tower
props.flavor: Alphabet blocks stacked taller than a knight, the top letter always facing whoever's watching.
props.summary: toy-block stack, alphabet-carved, tall pillar reskin

props.name: Grinning Crank-Box
props.flavor: A jack-in-the-box the size of a coffin, its crank turning on its own with nobody's hand near it.
props.summary: jack-in-the-box, self-turning crank, unsettling toy prop

props.name: Painted Charger
props.flavor: A carousel horse frozen mid-gallop on its pole, paint chipped where small hands once gripped the mane.
props.summary: carousel horse, frozen gallop, statue reskin

props.name: Sunken Sphere Pit
props.flavor: A pit of candy-colored balls deep enough to swallow a grown man, and soft enough that nobody hears him go under.
props.summary: ball pit, colorful and swallowing, pool reskin, no cover

props.name: Loaded Number-Cube
props.flavor: A die as tall as a door, its pips carved deep enough to trip a boot, forever showing the same fated face.
props.summary: oversized die, fixed fatal number, obelisk reskin

props.name: Sugar-Bark Lollipop Tree
props.flavor: A candy tree with a swirled trunk and hard-candy leaves that rattle like wind chimes when the wind picks up.
props.summary: lollipop tree, swirled trunk, tall pillar reskin

props.name: Split-Seam Effigy
props.flavor: A pinata shaped like a smiling monarch, swinging from its rope, spilling something other than candy when struck.
props.summary: hanging pinata effigy, swings and spills on impact

props.name: Marching-Band Cart
props.flavor: A parade float cart papered in gaudy bunting, its wheels locked mid-procession and going nowhere ever again.
props.summary: parade float, bunting-wrapped, standard cart reskin

props.name: Confetti-Choked Cannon
props.flavor: A party cannon tipped on its side, still smoldering faintly from a celebration that ended badly.
props.summary: tipped party cannon, faintly smoldering, brazier reskin

props.name: Storybook Lectern
props.flavor: An oversized picture-book propped open on a gilded stand, its pages turning to a story no one asked for.
props.summary: giant storybook stand, self-turning pages, altar reskin

props.name: Nutcracker Sentinel
props.flavor: A toy soldier carved rigid and grinning, painted eyes tracking anyone foolish enough to walk past.
props.summary: toy soldier statue, painted tracking eyes, guard prop

props.name: Tangled Marionette Rack
props.flavor: A wall hung with puppet strings and empty little harnesses, swaying though nothing hangs from them anymore.
props.summary: puppet-string rack, empty harnesses swaying, no cover

props.name: Tipped Teacup Ride
props.flavor: An overturned teacup-ride car big enough to hide a squad, its painted rim chipped from one too many spins.
props.summary: overturned teacup ride car, table-slab reskin, big cover

props.name: Bunting Archway
props.flavor: A parade-entrance arch strung with faded festival bunting, the fabric stiff and sun-bleached to bone.
props.summary: festival arch, faded bunting, tall passage frame

props.name: Music-Box Sentinel
props.flavor: A wind-up ballerina post cranks its tune on a loop, the melody thinning and warping with every pass.
props.summary: wind-up ballerina post, warping tune, lamp-post reskin

props.name: Prize-Counter Stall
props.flavor: A carnival game counter still stacked with plush prizes nobody ever came to claim.
props.summary: carnival prize counter, stacked plush, table reskin

props.name: Coiled Slide Tube
props.flavor: A helter-skelter slide coiled up like a shell, its mouth dark enough to hide what's waiting at the bottom.
props.summary: spiral playground slide, dark mouth, gate-slot reskin

props.name: Candy-Cage Kiosk
props.flavor: A cotton-candy kiosk gone sugar-crusted and hollow, its spinning drum locked mid-turn.
props.summary: sugar-crusted candy kiosk, seized spinning drum

props.name: Storm-Cloud Bounce House
props.flavor: An inflatable castle sagging on one deflated corner, breathing in slow labored wheezes from a dying blower.
props.summary: sagging inflatable castle, wheezing blower, soft mass

props.name: Ferris Gondola Husk
props.flavor: A single Ferris-wheel car snapped from its rig and left upright, door swinging on one bent hinge.
props.summary: detached ferris car, bent-hinge door, box cover

props.name: Ticket-Booth Husk
props.flavor: A gilded ticket booth chair still bolted to its stand, velvet rope looped uselessly around the post.
props.summary: gilded ticket-booth seat, looped velvet rope, throne reskin

props.name: Fun-House Mirror Rank
props.flavor: A row of warped mirrors on wheeled frames, each one stretching whoever passes into something else entirely.
props.summary: warped mirror row, stretched reflections, obelisk row

props.name: Piled Party Favors
props.flavor: A drift of popped streamers, spent noisemakers, and crushed paper hats swept into a heap nobody claimed.
props.summary: party-favor debris heap, generic clutter cover

props.name: Wax Figure Gallery
props.flavor: A row of wax-cast performers bolted along the wall, their painted smiles slowly softening in the heat.
props.summary: wax performer row, softening smiles, wall-mounted

props.name: Cotton-Candy Stalactites
props.flavor: Fibrous sugar-pink strands have crept and hardened over some churning mechanism, muffling its grinding gears.
props.summary: sugar-strand overgrowth, muffled machinery, no cover

props.name: Tournament Pavilion
props.flavor: A candy-striped tournament pavilion, pennants snapping, its shade a little too dark inside.
props.summary: striped tournament pavilion, half cover

props.name: Heraldic Banner Rank
props.flavor: A rank of tall heraldic banners on gilded poles, the blazons subtly wrong the longer you look.
props.summary: row of banner poles, half cover

props.name: Flower Planter Box
props.flavor: An overflowing flower planter of impossible blooms, petals turning to follow your face.
props.summary: overflowing flower planter, half cover

props.name: Reliquary Altar
props.flavor: A jeweled reliquary altar under glass, the relic within a small gold hand that beckons.
props.summary: jeweled reliquary altar, half cover

props.name: Carousel Horse
props.flavor: A gilded carousel horse frozen mid-gallop on its brass pole, its painted grin far too wide.
props.summary: carousel horse on pole, half cover

props.name: Gumdrop Fountain
props.flavor: A tiered fountain running with something too pink and too sweet, drawing wasps the size of thumbs.
props.summary: tiered candy fountain, half cover
